environment.store: SUBSTRATE_DATABASE_URL from gcloud secret ATOMS_DATABASE_URL, project hauska-prod-497015

missionPremise: Re-deriving envelopes over the six Phase-0 counties will show whether the residual is dominated by road-name and road-class failures; if it is, road data work must move earlier in the OPS-24 programme.
completionPredicate: A dry-run instrument re-derives envelopes, splits every decline into named failure classes (road-name and road-class separated) plus a road-free draw class plus an unclassified bucket, is falsified by self-test (an unrecognised failure lands in unclassified; a genuine draw is not counted as a failure), and reports a per-city residual with store digests identical before and after.
scopeBasis: Scope question is the programme-level one named in OPS-16 and the A-177 mission: does road data work move earlier. Basis for the per-city split is jurisdiction_tenant in the atoms store, which carries the county FIPS, so per-city attribution is available from the store without a new join.

reconFindings.claim: The atoms store is reachable read-only and the envelope population is attributable per city without a new join.
reconFindings.measurement: 168 (city, outcome-kind, zero-proof, reason) rows returned for active buildable-envelope atoms in the six Phase-0 counties, grouped by jurisdiction_tenant.

reconFindings.claim: jurisdiction_tenant is the per-city attribution axis and is populated on buildable-envelope atoms.
reconFindings.measurement: Population grouped cleanly by tenant with no null-tenant bucket in the returned rows.

reconFindings.claim: The re-derive cannot be built as a second pass over envelope atoms alone: parcel rings are not carried on parcel-node bodies.
reconFindings.measurement: parcel-node body carries geometryStoreRef {store: txgio_parcel, propId, countyFips} and geometryLoaded: true, but no ring vertices; the ring lives in the geometry store. property-boundary-edge bodies carry interior.edgeEndpoints in a LOCAL projected frame, while road-node bodies carry row.leftEdge/rightEdge as WGS84 LineStrings.
reconFindings.consequence: A re-derive needs the geometry store plus an explicit frame reconciliation between local-frame edge endpoints and WGS84 road polylines. This is an assembly problem, not a single-query problem.

reconFindings.claim: The six Phase-0 counties are NOT homogeneous in the inputs a road residual requires; in two of them a road residual is not measurable at all.
reconFindings.consequence: Three regimes. (a) 48021, 48055, 48209 hold boundary edges AND roads: a road residual is measurable. (b) 48309 holds roads but no boundary primitives. (c) 48453 and 48491 hold rules and outcomes but no roads and no boundaries: any road-name or road-class figure reported there would be an artifact of absent inputs, not a measured road failure. A programme-wide road residual quoted over all six counties would be partly an input-absence artifact.

reconFindings.claim: facingRoad is set on a minority of boundary edges, so edge labelling is itself partial.
Road nodes include pedestrian ways that must not count as road failures.
reconFindings.consequence: Directly relevant to the dispatch falsifier that a genuine draw must not be counted as a failure: pedestrian filter must be applied before any road-class bucket is incremented.

reconFindings.claim: The warning that county 48491 must not be touched is load-bearing, not theoretical.
reconFindings.measurement: 48491 holds the second-largest envelope population of the six on the index probe (239491 decline rows and 42945 buildable rows previously observed) while holding zero road and zero boundary atoms.

reconFindings.claim: Re-implementing the derive inside the P-264 instrument would create a second implementation of an existing rule.
reconFindings.measurement: packages/engine-core/src/depth-warm/warm-then-verify.ts already orchestrates computeWarmCandidate -> verifyWarmCandidateMechanically, consume.ts already exposes computeWarmCandidateFromBoundary, and scripts/depth-warm-city-batch.mjs already assembles per-parcel inputs from live sources and emits per-parcel decline buckets. P-262's labeller is a separate pass that runs AFTER the derive (re-labelling on stored geometry, no re-derive), and geometry/envelope-ground-truth.ts already owns the P1/P2/P3 predicates.
reconFindings.consequence: P-264 must AGGREGATE the existing derive's refusal taxonomy into the per-city residual, not write a third derive. A parallel derive would also make the residual unfalsifiable against production.

designDecision.decision: Build P-264 as an aggregation instrument over the existing depth-warm derive refusal taxonomy, not as a new derive.
designDecision.rationale: DEV-PROCESS measuring-classes-directly and one-implementation rules; a second derive would both duplicate and diverge from the shipped path, and its residual would not be attributable to production behaviour.
designDecision.openQuestion: Whether the existing batch runner's decline buckets separate road-NAME from road-CLASS, or collapse them. If they collapse, P-264 must extend the bucket spelling at the single source rather than post-split on strings.

preRegisteredFalsifiers: An unrecognised failure reason must land in the unclassified bucket; if it is silently dropped or absorbed into a road bucket, the instrument is wrong.
A genuine draw (a parcel with a real settlement envelope, or a pedestrian-way edge) must not increment any failure bucket.
A location with no road nodes at all must report road coverage as absent (an honest absence), NOT as a road-name or road-class failure.
Store digests taken before and after the run must be identical; any difference means the run was not a dry run.
notYetMeasured: The per-city road-name / road-class residual split itself. This is UNMEASURED.
The outcome of the 123706 reason-less zeros under re-derivation. This is UNMEASURED.
The write-proof digests (not yet taken, because no run has occurred).
The list of road-dominated cities. This depends on the above and is therefore UNMEASURED.
remainingWork: Read the existing batch runner's refusal bucket vocabulary and confirm road-name vs road-class separation at the source.
Implement the aggregation instrument plus self-tests for the four pre-registered falsifiers.
Take heavy-scan lease; take store digests; run bounded dry run; retake digests and reconcile.
File CP2 and CLOSE with the per-city residual, the unclassified bucket, and leave_behind.
